title: Huckleberry Metric2 High Value Outliers
dataSources: brightwheel check-ins (`brightwheel:checkin`), Procare attendance (`procare:attendance`), Huckleberry sleep logs (`huckleberry:sleep`), daycare incidents (`daycare:incident`), and nanny timesheets (`nanny:timesheet`).
app: brightwheel check-in exports, Procare attendance logs, Huckleberry sleep tracking, daycare incident reports, and nanny timesheet entries streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=huckleberry:metric2 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in huckleberry metric2 (2) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme huckleberry metric2 (2) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It rates the unusually high or low value moments in your huckleberry metric2 (2) history.
